metadata.geometry: Uses saved analytic-reference raw samples and exact saved local/wide queries. No route, query, RNG or movement is regenerated.

local.interpretation: Per-sample and stage errors compare production raw samples against continuous-reference raw samples under identical frozen geometry.

errorContraction.note: Raw, profile and L/C/R errors share field-value units. Strength, coherence, balance and steering have distinct units/scales and are reported separately.

cueGeometry.classification: ambiguous when analytic steering is within 64*Number.EPSILON*max(1, local raw magnitude); weak is above that precision floor and no larger than the shape-local median non-ambiguous analytic |steering|; clear is above that median.

wide.interpretation: Frozen analytic and production raw transverse samples pass through the exact saved five-candidate geometry. The rank score reproduces the prior deterministic field-only research score; it is not a stochastic AntController choice.

firstProductionWinnerDepartureFromAnalyt.definition: Within each final strict-unique mismatch, compare the production winner at raw maxima, weighted max, Hill response and final score against the analytic final-score winner; record the first production stage that is already wrong.

margins.noPostHocStrata: Margins are continuous; exact/tied winners are excluded by the source strict-unique flag.

hill.orderProperty: The positive-exponent Hill response is strictly increasing for nonnegative inputs; it preserves each branch candidate order. Any new rank order can arise only from the later confidence-dependent directional score, not Hill alone.
